decisions.reason: The approved power-supply and controller specifications support the existing load-capacity requirement but do not change its required reliability behavior.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording approval of the revised BOM and removal of the pending revision requirement.
Approval of the revised electrical components does not alter bowl capacity, form, or size preferences.
The increased electrical capacity can support the solenoids, but it does not change the required dispensing mechanism or button-actuation behavior.
Higher-power PWM controllers do not change the previously confirmed speed range, maximum motor speed, or variable-speed behavior.
The approved electrical component ratings do not change the whisk head, material, size, or positioning criteria.
The power-system component selection does not modify the required smoothness, froth, consistency, or high-speed mixing result.
Approval of the electrical BOM does not alter the splash-control target or approved mechanical mitigation methods.
The approved higher-capacity off-the-shelf electrical components remain consistent with the existing V1 component strategy and do not modify it.
The selected component ratings are inputs to the wiring plan, but the source does not change the wiring-plan deliverable or establish new wiring requirements.
The electrical BOM approval does not change the leak-prevention, sealing, or closed-valve drip requirements.
The approved power supply and motor controllers do not alter bowl-removal clearance or rapid bowl-swapping behavior.
